QuestInfo.name: Again and Again
QuestInfo.0: Amnesiac Temple Keeper drinks the All Forgetting Potion to forget everything but the temple keeper is worried about losing the memory again.
QuestInfo.1: The Amnesiac Temple Keeper wanted information on his lost memories. No wonder the others didn't want to help.
QuestInfo.2: You realize that the Amnesiac Temple Keeper goes through the process of losing memory and finding memory over and over again. You go tell Johanna never to give the potion to erase memory again.

speech.0: Did he lose his memories again? I see. This has been a cycle... I knew he'd seek his memories again at some point.
It's stupid to let the past control you...
Did #rKao#k erase his memories again? I do wonder what he experienced that was so ruinous...
#rKao'#k been erasing and returning his memories for awhile now. Makes sense...he gets rid of them, forgets whatever it was that was so terrible, tries to get them back, and so on...

npc.0: I don't remember anything. Who am I?
